office_does: The District Court judge hears misdemeanor, traffic and small civil cases for all of Lincoln County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Dan B. Johnson, on the bench since 2015, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lincoln County District Court judge since 2015 and former Stevens County deputy prosecutor; served six years on the state Board for Judicial Administration.
highlights: Attorney since 1980; Stevens County deputy prosecutor 1981-1987 [S1]
Board for Judicial Administration member for six years from 2016 [S1]
